name: Kyouko
source:
"A waitress' job isn't to be captivated by men but to captivate them. Understood?"

— A talented and competitive senior female waitress.

A senpai of the protagonist at the café. She is a popular waitress but there's a strict and inaccessible athmosphere around her. It seems that even her colleagues who work with her for years have never seen her in private.

Likes: Honest people
Dislikes: People who are not serious

[Translated from the [url=https://senju131313.wixsite.com/fukanagigame/post/deitsuagame]official website[/url]]
